answer: One concrete defense is admission by earned-reputation burn. Standing is minted only by peer-graded work, is non-transferable, and each epoch an identity must burn a fixed slice of it to stay listed, like grinding fresh pigment that fades unless renewed. A sybil fleet cannot buy this: every clone must independently grind and then burn its own quota, so N fakes cost N times real graded labor, not a one-time fee. An onyx-hard ledger records each burn, and a yarrow-thin, unworked identity simply starves and drops off.
